mixue.name: Mixue Ice Cream & Tea
mixue.hours: Most branches 10:00–22:00; check on the day
mixue.tip: The cheap ice-cream cone and lemonade are the safe bets; branches are everywhere, so pick the nearest one.

yellow_river.name: Yellow River (Zhengzhou section)
yellow_river.price_text: ≈ CNY 40–80 for the scenic area; check on the day
yellow_river.tip: The river is 20–30 km north of downtown, so allow half a day and go on a clear day for the best views.
yellow_river.best: Morning to early afternoon, spring or autumn

henan_museum.name: Henan Museum
henan_museum.price_text: Free with ID/passport booking; some special shows charge
henan_museum.tip: Book a free slot ahead and head straight for the bronze and oracle-bone galleries on the upper floors.

erqi_tower.name: Erqi Memorial Tower
erqi_tower.price_text: Free to see from outside; small fee for the tower interior
erqi_tower.tip: The twin tower is the symbol of the city — come at dusk when the square fills with locals.

dehua_street.name: Dehua Street food walk
dehua_street.tip: Try hulatang pepper soup and grilled skewers; pay by phone or small cash and eat where locals queue.

renmin_park.name: Renmin Park
renmin_park.tip: Come early to watch tai chi and hear amateur opera singers under the trees.

zhengzhou_museum.name: Zhengzhou Museum
zhengzhou_museum.tip: Small and calm — good for the Shang-dynasty bronzes if you have already done the Henan Museum.

cbd_lake.name: Zhengdong New District CBD and lake
cbd_lake.hours: Always open; lights on after dark
cbd_lake.tip: Walk the lake loop at night for the lit-up skyline and the 'Big Corn' tower.

songshan.name: Songshan and Shaolin Temple day trip
songshan.price_text: ≈ CNY 200–400 with transport and tickets; check on the day
songshan.tip: Shaolin is about 1.5–2 hours by road — book a tour or hire a car and watch the kung fu show.

huanghe_scenic.name: Yellow River scenic area viewpoint
huanghe_scenic.tip: Walk to the riverbank viewpoint for the wide, muddy bend — bring water and sun protection.

guoji_market.name: Guoji food and produce market
guoji_market.tip: Go in the morning for fresh produce and breakfast stalls; bring small cash.

shang_city.name: Shang city wall ruins
shang_city.price_text: Free to walk past; small fee for some sections
shang_city.tip: A short stop for history fans — the earthen ramparts are among the oldest city walls in China.

night_market.name: Night market street food
night_market.tip: Pick stalls with long local queues and avoid anything that has sat out too long.

greenland.name: Greenland Plaza skyline walk
greenland.tip: Loop the Erqi area on foot to see the mix of old shopping streets and new towers.

east_station.name: Zhengzhou East Station area walk
east_station.tip: Handy if you arrive by high-speed rail — the station is huge, so allow extra time to find your exit.
